DUNGEONS AND DRAGONS 
Dungeons & Dragons (commonly abbreviated as D&D or DnD) is a fantasy tabletop role-playing game (RPG) originally designed by Gary Gygax and Dave Arneson. It was first published in 1974 by Tactical Studies Rules, Inc. (TSR).It has been published by Wizards of the Coast (now a subsidiary of Hasbro) since 1997. The game was derived from miniature wargames, with a variation of the 1971 game Chainmail serving as the initial rule system. D&D's publication is commonly recognized as the beginning of modern role-playing games and the role-playing game industry.
In January 2012, Wizards of the Coast announced that a new edition of the game, at the time referred to as D&D Next, was under development. In direct contrast to the previous editions of the game, D&D Next was developed partly via a public open playtest. An early build of the new edition debuted at the 2012 Dungeons & Dragons Experience event to about 500 fans. Public playtesting began on May 24, 2012, with the final playtest packet released on September 20, 2013.
Mechanically, 5th edition draws heavily on prior editions, while introducing some new mechanics intended to simplify and streamline play. Skills, weapons, items, saving throws, and other things that characters are trained in now all use a single proficiency bonus that increases as character level increases. Multiple defense values have been removed, returning to a single defense value of armor class and using more traditional saving throws. Saving throws are reworked to be situational checks based on the six core abilities instead of generic d20 rolls. Feats are now optional features that can be taken instead of ability score increases and are reworked to be occasional major upgrades instead of frequent minor upgrades.
Dungeons & Dragons immerses you in a world of adventure. Explore ancient ruins and deadly dungeons. Battle monsters while searching for legendary treasures. Gain experience and power as you trek across uncharted lands with your companions.

Tensiunile au continuat si dupa terminarea emisiunii! Ionescu si Valentin au ajuns intr-o discutie aprinsa, iar nemultumirile tanarului au iesit rapid la iveala. 

Revenirea Andreei pare sa fi complicat situatia pentru Ionescu, care se simte pus intr-o postura dificila. In urma aparitiei fostei concurente, au aparut si discutii despre neasumarea lui, iar Valentin nu a ezitat sa intervina.

Valentin a adus in discutie inclusiv reactia Izabelei, iubita lui Ionescu, sugerand ca, daca pana si aceasta considera ca exista o problema, atunci acuzatiile ar putea avea un sambure de adevar. Ionescu a incercat sa explice ca a facut anumite schimbari, insa Valentin nu s-a lasat convins si l-a taxat printr-o replica directa: „Tot la mine ajungi. Nu inteleg!”. De ce ajung cei doi sa revina mereu la aceleasi reprosuri? Sa fie de vina activitatea pe care Valentin si Izabela au avut-o astazi in gradina?

Ձեր կարծիքով՝ Վահիկը կզղջա՞ իր արարքի համար, թե՞ նոր խնդիրներ կստեղծի. գրեք մեկնաբանություններում և բաժանորդագրվեք ալիքին:

00:19 Լուրջ խոսակցություն Վահիկի արարքների մասին
00:33 Անսպասելի այցելություն հիվանդանոց և սիրո խոստովանություն

Flores De Sangre 🥀

Todo comenzó años atrás, con una disputa de sangre entre dos familias. En aquel entonces, Baran era apenas un niño cuando perdió a su madre, Ayten, mientras que su padre, Kudret, perdió el habla y quedó condenado a una silla de ruedas. Su abuela Azade crió a Baran y a su hermano Cihan, recordándoles constantemente que debían vengar a su familia.

Seyid, perteneciente al otro bando de la disputa, huyó a Estambul con su familia. Junto a su esposa Hanife y sus hijos Cevdet, Dilan y Zümrüt, comenzó una nueva vida. Años después, cuando los Karabey encontraron el rastro de Seyid, había llegado el momento de la venganza.

Sin embargo, Baran tenía un plan diferente al dictado por la tradición. Decidido a poner fin a años de enemistad, su encuentro con Dilan lo obligó a tomar la decisión más importante de su vida.
